name: aurora-background
title: Aurora Background
description: Soft glowing color fields that drift slowly behind your content, made from primary and an accent token.

props.name: color
props.description: Accent token mixed with primary in the glow.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the glow drifts: 24s, 14s, or 8s per cycle.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the glow.

a11y: The glow layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
With reduced motion, the glow stops moving and stays in its starting position.
The glow is light enough that ink and muted text keep their contrast.

ai.whenToUse: A calm, colorful backdrop for a landing hero, pricing CTA, or sign-in screen.
rules: Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Use one aurora per view; it is meant as the main backdrop
Use speed=slow behind long text so the motion does not distract

id.description: Bidang warna bercahaya yang bergeser pelan di belakang konten, dari token primary dan satu token aksen.

props.color: Token aksen yang dicampur dengan primary di cahaya.
props.speed: Kecepatan gerak cahaya: 24s, 14s, atau 8s per siklus.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas cahaya.

a11y: Lapisan cahaya memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Dengan reduced motion, cahaya berhenti dan tetap di posisi awal.
Cahaya cukup tipis sehingga teks ink dan muted tetap kontras.

ai.whenToUse: Latar tenang dan berwarna untuk hero landing, CTA harga, atau layar masuk.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Pakai satu aurora per tampilan; ini dimaksudkan sebagai latar utama
Pakai speed=slow di belakang teks panjang supaya gerakan tidak mengganggu
